title: Home For Rent | 6107 Catania Dr, Temple, TX
description:
🏡 Home for Rent in Bella Terra Subdivision! 🏡

Welcome home to this gorgeous semi-custom built gem, nestled in the sought-after Bella Terra community! 🌿 Just 6 minutes from I-35 and a quick 5-minute drive to Scott & White Hospital, this home is perfect for anyone who needs to be on the go. But don’t let the convenience fool you—this property is designed for relaxation! With a large patio, fire pit, and nearly a quarter-acre lot, you’ll have the perfect outdoor space to unwind.

Inside this stunning 2022-built home, you’ll find 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, quartz countertops, and a modern kitchen featuring a gas stove and a pot filler (yes, we mentioned the pot filler 😉). Tile flooring throughout, energy-efficient appliances, plus a washer and dryer included!

This smoke-free, pet-friendly home is waiting for you and your fur babies (with some pet conditions applied). HOA fees are covered with the rent, and tenants must provide proof of renter's insurance for the lease term.

No smoking anywhere on the property. Application required before showings. 📋 Don’t miss out on this beauty—schedule a viewing today!

✨ Features:

4 beds, 2 baths
Wood-burning fireplace
Quartz countertops & gas stove
Tile flooring throughout
Large patio & fire pit
Energy-efficient appliances
Washer & dryer included
Pet-friendly

Rent: $2,350/month
